GOD'S WORD
For when you've lost someone
Verses and a few quiet words to say, for the days and the nights after a loss. Take only what helps.
The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
PSALM 34:18 · KJV
My heart is broken. I do not have to hide that from God. He comes near to the broken, so I let Him come near to me.
Jesus wept.
JOHN 11:35 · KJV
Jesus wept for His friend Lazarus, even knowing what He was about to do. My tears are not a lack of faith. I can cry, and He understands.
Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
MATTHEW 5:4 · KJV
I am allowed to mourn. I do not have to rush it, and I do not have to explain it to anyone.

Me doy permiso para estar de luto. No tengo que apurarme, ni darle explicaciones a nadie.

SALMOS 56:8 · RV1909

For Such a Time as This
Retold with AI help and checked before publishing.
RETELLING
Esther was a young Jewish woman living in Shushan, the capital of Persia. Her mother and father had died, and her cousin Mordecai raised her like his own daughter. In time, King Ahasuerus chose her to be queen. But Mordecai told her to keep quiet about who her people were, and she did.
Then a powerful man named Haman talked the king into signing an evil order. On one day, the Jews in every province of the kingdom were to be destroyed. Letters went out under the king's seal.
When Mordecai heard it, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and ashes. He cried a loud and bitter cry right in the middle of the city. All over the provinces, Jewish families fasted and wept.

log.text:
←  Back
KING JAMES VERSION
Psalm 23
Books and chapters
Search
Saved and highlighted
1  A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
2  He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
3  He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
4  Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
5  Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
6  Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

3  Confortará mi alma; guiaráme por sendas de justicia por amor de su nombre.

He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
3
He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
4
Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou 
art
 with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
5
Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
